assumptions.text: Coordinate-construction provenance remains correlated with elliptic addition after exact D2 multiplicity and inversion symmetry are matched.
A smaller exact inverse-route relation can reduce online candidate enumeration without transferring the same cost into advice.
Exhaustive supports, scalar controls, and independent order checks are feasible only for generated toy groups.

falsification_route: Reject or narrow the tested source tags if exact coverage fails, either null invariant differs, or candidate payload and verified query work do not beat every effective null. Classify a null-only win as structural unless it also beats the exact D2, partial/full D4, and equal-advice BSGS envelope.
model_of_computation: Classical fixed-curve preprocessing with affine EC and field-operation counters, explicit serialized advice, logical memory reads, and exact candidate verification.
next_experiment: Run the disclosed noncanonical 10/12/14-bit sweep only after the v2 generator, independent verifier, mutation tests, and second pre-run review pass.
parameter_regime: Generated ordinary prime-order short-Weierstrass curves over prime fields; development sizes 10-14 bits.
statement: Compositional factor-base provenance makes the exact D2+D2 inverse join cheaper than both compositional source permutations and occupancy-, inversion-, witness-class-, and multiplicity-matched random source tags.
